quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q customer concentration and channel, Q2 2026 (customers not named): direct sales were $162,256 thousand (+24.8% year over year from $129,996 thousand) and distributor sales $283,273 thousand (+19.9% from $236,216 thousand) of Q2 net sales of $445,529 thousand. quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q capex and supply commitments: purchases of property, plant and equipment were $65.5 million in the six months ended June 30, 2026, or 7.7% of net sales (versus $36,338 thousand a year earlier), and the company expects 2026 capital expenditures within its target model of 5% to 9% of net sales. At June 30, 2026 Diodes had non-cancelable purchase contracts for capital expenditures, primarily for manufacturing equipment, of approximately $94.4 million and a commitment to purchase approximately $44.2 million of wafers for its manufacturing process, scheduled through 2031.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 capex $65.5 million (7.7% of net sales); equipment purchase contracts approximately $94.4 million; wafer purchase commitment approximately $44.2 million through 2031

quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q supplier disclosure - Supplier Nuvoton (related party): in the six months ended June 30, 2026 Diodes purchased approximately $1.4 million of wafers from Nuvoton under an agreement that ended in the second quarter of 2026, and it plans to continue its strategic alliance with Nuvoton; purchases from Nuvoton were $3,678 thousand in Q2 2026 versus $1,278 thousand a year earlier.
